series.title: General Inspection, Investigation, Enforcement, and Compliance

roles.functionStatement: Establish, with defensible evidence, whether regulated facilities and sites meet their permits and rules, and start the response the enforcement policy requires.

instruments.label: EPA civil penalty and enforcement response policies

bands.indicativeBand: GS-5 to GS-7 (entry); GS-9 to GS-11 (journey)

majorDuties.duty: Conduct regulatory compliance inspections

tasks.statement: Inspect a permitted facility or site against its permit conditions and applicable rules, recording observations, measurements and samples as evidence
Write an inspection report stating findings of fact for each condition inspected, separating the inspector's observations from conclusions
Plan a compliance inspection from the facility's permit, compliance history and monitoring reports, listing the conditions to verify and the evidence to collect
Collect samples and photographs during an inspection under chain-of-custody procedures, so that the evidence is admissible in an enforcement proceeding
Select the response the enforcement policy sets for each inspection finding, issuing a notice of violation, assistance letter or referral

majorDuties.duty: Develop and resolve environmental enforcement cases

tasks.statement: Investigate a reported environmental violation, establishing the facts, responsible party and applicable requirement before recommending an enforcement response
Assemble the evidence file for an enforcement case, linking each alleged violation to the inspection findings, records and samples that prove it

majorDuties.duty: Target inspections and verify compliance using monitoring data and analytics

tasks.statement: Review automated anomaly flags in facility monitoring reports, confirming or dismissing each flag against the underlying data before referral
Verify a facility's self-reported emissions or discharge values against independent remote-sensing or ambient data, stating the discrepancy and its uncertainty

majorDuties.duty: Manage field sample custody and field quality control

tasks.statement: Complete chain-of-custody records for every sample from collection to laboratory receipt, recording each transfer, seal and temperature check
Collect field duplicates, splits and blanks at the frequency the sampling plan specifies, labelling them so the laboratory cannot identify them

majorDuties.duty: Measure water quality and survey aquatic communities in the field

tasks.statement: Collect grab water samples at locations and depths that represent the condition of interest, recording flow and site conditions at collection

majorDuties.duty: Validate AI-generated work products before professional use

tasks.statement: Check an AI-assisted regulatory analysis or compliance summary against the applicable legal text and source records before it enters a decision document.
Verify an AI-generated field product, such as a condition map or drafted inspection note, against observations made at the site before it is relied on

majorDuties.duty: Provide compliance and technical assistance to regulated entities and local governments

tasks.statement: Visit a small regulated facility on request to identify compliance gaps, recommending corrective steps without initiating enforcement where policy allows
Answer compliance questions from regulated entities through a help line or portal, recording each question and the guidance given for consistency review

majorDuties.duty: Work safely on hazardous, industrial and energized field sites

tasks.statement: Identify signs of potential hazardous materials at a field site, such as drums, stained soil, odours or unusual debris, before disturbing them
Follow a site health and safety plan at a contaminated or industrial site, observing zone boundaries, air-monitoring action levels and decontamination steps
Keep required clearances from energized lines, confined spaces and operating machinery during field work at utility and industrial sites, stopping when clearance cannot be held

majorDuties.duty: Assure the quality of environmental data from collection to release

tasks.statement: Audit an environmental dataset on a set schedule, identifying errors and anomalies and recording each correction with its basis.

majorDuties.duty: Maintain independence and manage conflicts of interest across the regulator-regulated boundary

tasks.statement: Recuse from a decision or review in which a former employer or client has an interest, documenting the recusal and the reassignment of the work
Disclose financial, employment or relationship interests that could affect an assignment before work begins, using the organization's conflict form

majorDuties.duty: Build and maintain a defensible administrative record

tasks.statement: Index documents into the administrative record with dates, authors and provenance labels, marking which content was produced with AI assistance

majorDuties.duty: Apply safety practices and stop-work authority across field, facility and incident settings

tasks.statement: Exercise stop-work authority when field, facility or incident conditions exceed the stated safety limits of the assignment

knowledgeStatements: A no-blame incident review separates system and condition causes from individual error and sanctions only reckless or wilful acts, so that people keep reporting near misses.
Stop-work authority lets any worker halt a task they judge unsafe; the task resumes only after the hazard is assessed and the plan revised, and the person who stopped it is not penalized.
